DEVIATION 550, ORIGINAL to mojolearn. The minimum-norm least squares w = A^T (A A^T)^+ b for n_cols > n_rows, where cuML has only lstsqSvdJacobi (cusolverDnGesvdj, a one-sided Jacobi SVD in a closed library). Nothing upstream corresponds: it is six of lstsq_eig's own steps with n_rows where that writes n_cols, plus w = A^T z. The old refusal's reason was right about A^T A and does not transfer to A A^T, which is n_rows x n_rows and nonsingular at full row rank. It squares the condition number exactly as lstsq_eig does on the tall side, so it is not an SVD-quality route and its docstring says which algorithm would be (LQ, or a one-sided Jacobi SVD of A^T)
